summary: Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release inviting participants to a Q1 2026 results webcast scheduled for May 14, 2026. The filing is purely an earnings announcement notification with no merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, divestiture, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, rights offering, going-private transaction, capital return, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. It is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer notifying the market of an ordinary earnings event.
